beats.say: Sir Georg Solti sits in second place with 31 wins.
Quincy Jones holds the record for a producer with 28 awards.
Kendrick Lamar is the most awarded rapper with 27.
Chick Corea has won 29 awards, more than any other jazz artist.
Santanas Supernatural holds the record for most honored album having won nine awards in 2000.
